env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# An exported generic instantiation with an unexported type argument is not
# spellable by a different holder package: the checker must reject the
# pointer union member just as the generated decoder does, instead of
# accepting the exported origin while ignoring its arguments. The union is
# defined in lib where the argument is same-package, so lib builds; the
# importer in main cannot name the argument, so main must fail.
cd bad
! logos run .
stderr 'points to an unexported type'

-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/unionhiddengenericarg

go 1.27
-- bad/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type hidden struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

type Box[T any] struct {
	V T `json:"v"`
}

func (b *Box[T]) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error { return nil }

type Other struct {
	Y string `json:"y"`
}

func (o *Other) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error { return nil }

type U interface {
	*Box[hidden] | *Other
}
-- bad/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/unionhiddengenericarg/lib"

type H struct {
	Item lib.U `json:"item"`
}

func main() {
	var h H
	_ = h
}
